title: INSPECT CONNECTING RODS / REPLACEMENT OF ROD BUSHING

content.text: (a) Using a rod aligner, check the connecting rod alignment.

content.description: Illustration showing connecting rod alignment check using rod aligner tool, with arrows indicating measurement direction

items: Check that the rod is not bent.
Check that the rod is not twisted.

content.text: If the rod is bent or twisted, replace the connecting rod.
(b) Measure the oil clearance between the rod bushing and piston pin.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of rod bushing inside diameter using inside dial indicator and measurement of piston pin diameter using micrometer

items: Using an inside dial indicator, measure the inside diameter of the rod bushing.
Using a micrometer, measure the diameter of the piston pin.
Check that the difference between the measurements is less than the oil clearance limit.

content.text: If the clearance is greater than maximum, replace the rod bushing.
Using SST, remove the rod bushing from the connecting rod.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rod bushing using SST tool

content.text: Using SST, install the rod bushing to the connecting rod.
NOTE: Align the bushing oil hole with the connecting rod oil hole.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of new rod bushing with oil hole alignment
